The '''Pammant Prowler-250''' was a [[fishing]] [[Boat|ship]] manufactured by [[United Dac Engineering Corps]]. The boat possessed two [[engine]]s that sat above the [[water]], with additional below the surface. A group of [[Quarren]] sailors on the [[moon]] [[Trask]] used one such [[Quarren fishing vessel|vessel]], which was weather-beaten and sturdy.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
